title: Riverbend Medical Hardship Assistance — Coverage-Terminated Liabilities in a Renewal Claim
content:
1. Under the Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care), the coverage-gap account is the patient's Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) account carrying the patient's most recent coverage-terminated liability (an amount an insurer released because coverage had ended before the date of service; on a same-day tie, the liability listed first in the account activity).
2. Its coverage-terminated balance is its coverage-terminated liabilities of the twelve months less every uninsured discount of the twelve months posted on the coverage-gap account (a discount granted on those liabilities after coverage ended included), and that balance is taken off the medical debt a renewal claims in one of three ways:
   - (a) when the patient holds a BadgerCare Plus (Wisconsin Medicaid) Claim under Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing), all of that balance is taken off;
   - (b) when the patient holds no BadgerCare Plus claim, a BadgerCare Plus determination notice has been accepted on the renewal case, and the coverage-gap account is coded emergency or medically necessary, the part of that balance above the amounts-generally-billed share of those liabilities — the program's amounts-generally-billed percentage (34.6 percent on every tier) of them, rounded half-up to the cent — is taken off, nothing coming off a balance already at or below that share;
   - (c) otherwise, including when the coverage-gap account is coded elective, nothing is taken off for them.
3. Coverage-terminated liabilities on any other account stand as posted.
4. For this rule a posting belongs to the twelve months when fewer than twelve whole months separate its posting date from the signing day; a whole month runs from a day of one month to the same day of the next month or, when the next month has no such day, to the first day of the month after it, so a posting dated on the signing day's day of the month twelve months earlier is already outside.

**Condition combinations under 2(b)** (no BadgerCare Plus claim held):

| Determination notice accepted on the renewal case | Coverage-gap account coding | Taken off |
|---|---|---|
| yes | emergency or medically necessary | the part of the balance above the amounts-generally-billed share, if any |
| yes | elective | nothing |
| no | any | nothing |

Hypothetical under 2(b): coverage-terminated liabilities of 2,000.00 with an uninsured discount of 800.00 posted on the account in the twelve months; the balance is 1,200.00 and the share 692.00, so 508.00 is taken off. With a discount of 1,400.00 the balance, 600.00, is below 692.00 and nothing is taken off.
